title: longread-rnaseq-pipeline parameters
description: Parameters for platform-aware alignment, production IsoQuant transcript discovery, caller benchmarking, and production biological analysis of human bulk long-read RNA-seq data.

help.description: Print concise command-line usage and exit without executing the workflow.

outdir.description: Directory for pipeline outputs and execution metadata.

fasta.description: Explicit path to the human reference genome FASTA.

gtf.description: Explicit path to the matching GENCODE GTF annotation.

genome_build.description: Declared genome build, initially expected to be GRCh38.

annotation_release.description: Declared annotation provider and release, for example GENCODE 49.

mode.description: Production transcriptome, comparative caller benchmark, or production biological-analysis mode.

execution_profile.description: Human-readable execution environment recorded in summaries.

annotation_guided_alignment.description: Reserved switch for reproducible annotation-guided alignment. Block 1B rejects true because guided alignment is not yet implemented; default alignments remain annotation-unguided.

lima_peek_guess.description: Enable lima --peek-guess for PacBio primer sets where that behaviour is appropriate.

isoseq_include_singletons.description: Pass --singletons to isoseq cluster2. Disabled by default and recorded in provenance.

large_file_publish_mode.description: Nextflow publish mode for large BAM and FASTQ outputs; link avoids duplicate data on a shared filesystem.

max_cpus.description: Maximum CPU request enforced through Nextflow resourceLimits.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory request enforced through Nextflow resourceLimits.

max_time.description: Maximum task duration enforced through Nextflow resourceLimits.

isoquant_report_novel_unspliced.description: Override IsoQuant's data-type-specific novel single-exon reporting policy. Null preserves the pinned tool-native default (false for ONT, true for other data types).

transcriptome_filtering.description: Reserved switch for a future explicit curation policy. Block 2 rejects true and always preserves the raw discovered transcriptome.

flair_min_support.description: FLAIR transcriptome minimum supporting reads. The pinned FLAIR 3.0.1 default is retained.

flair_end_window.description: FLAIR TSS/TES clustering window in bases. This affects discovery and is recorded in provenance.

benchmark_end_bins.description: Comma-separated inclusive absolute TSS/TES difference bins in bases; analytical summaries, not biological truth thresholds.

benchmark_single_exon_reciprocal_overlap.description: Minimum reciprocal genomic overlap for grouping single-exon models on the same chromosome and strand.

contrast_numerator.description: Explicit Block 4 contrast numerator condition; must be paired with contrast_denominator.

contrast_denominator.description: Explicit Block 4 contrast denominator condition; must be paired with contrast_numerator.

block4_design_formula.description: No-intercept R design formula for edgeR and satuRn; condition is required and sample metadata columns may be added as covariates.

minimum_biological_replicates.description: Minimum distinct biological replicate labels required in each contrasted condition.

block4_fdr.description: Reported multiple-testing threshold; effect sizes remain available independently.

transcript_end_cluster_window.description: Configurable coordinate window for descriptive putative TSS/TES clustering.

transdecoder_min_peptide_length.description: Minimum candidate peptide length supplied to TransDecoder.

transdecoder_single_best_only.description: Ask TransDecoder to retain only one ORF per transcript; false preserves alternative candidates.

enable_functional_enrichment.description: Enable local human GO enrichment using the testable gene universe; no external pathway service is queried.

report_run_id.description: Optional stable report run identifier. Empty uses the Nextflow run name.
